note: KPI packs loaded at startup. Add an industry by adding a block here (or in the app under KPI Library). Existing definitions edited in the app are never overwritten.

kpis.name: Gross profit per job
kpis.description: Average gross profit earned on each completed job.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review estimating and change-order capture on the lowest-margin jobs.
kpis.dataSource: Management P&L; job count from project tracking

kpis.name: Revenue per field labor hour
kpis.description: Sales produced for each hour of field labor.
kpis.recommendedAction: Compare crews and job types; look for unbilled time.
kpis.dataSource: Management P&L; field hours from payroll or timekeeping

kpis.name: Change orders as % of revenue
kpis.description: Share of revenue coming from approved change orders.
kpis.recommendedAction: Confirm every scope change is priced and signed before work proceeds.

kpis.name: Backlog (months of revenue)
kpis.description: Signed work not yet completed, expressed as months of current revenue.
kpis.recommendedAction: If backlog is thin, prioritize estimating and follow-up on open proposals.

kpis.name: Actual vs estimated job cost
kpis.description: Actual cost of completed jobs relative to the estimate. Above 100% means jobs ran over.
kpis.recommendedAction: Feed overruns back into the estimating templates.

kpis.name: Variable (job) expenses as % of revenue
kpis.description: Materials, subcontractors and field labor per dollar of revenue — the costs that decide whether jobs make money.
kpis.recommendedAction: Hold the percentage on healthy work; where it slipped, look at supplier pricing, subcontractor agreements and incentive pay.

kpis.name: Fixed (overhead) expenses as % of revenue
kpis.description: Overhead per dollar of revenue.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review overhead line by line: same, more or less than last year, and why.

kpis.name: Net profit margin
kpis.description: Pretax profit kept from each dollar of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Work the levers in order: price, volume sold, variable costs, fixed costs.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Contractor Budget" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites a healthy contractor net profit of 10%–20%.

kpis.name: Retainage as % of receivables
kpis.description: Share of receivables held back until project completion.
kpis.recommendedAction: Track release dates and close out punch lists promptly.

sources: Sera: 4 Metrics That Matter Most to Your HVAC Business

kpis.name: Memberships vs target
kpis.description: Active maintenance memberships compared with the target.
kpis.recommendedAction: Have technicians quote membership savings on every call.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Sera 4 Metrics" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites members generating up to 2.5× the revenue of non-members.

kpis.name: Memberships per $1M of annual revenue
kpis.description: Membership base relative to the size of the business (this month annualized).
kpis.recommendedAction: Grow memberships to smooth seasonal cash flow.

kpis.name: Technician efficiency (labor utilization)
kpis.description: Hours billed to customers relative to hours technicians were paid.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review dispatching, travel time and parts runs.

kpis.name: Average ticket
kpis.description: Average revenue per completed job or service call.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review pricing model and options presented on each call.

kpis.name: Revenue per technician
kpis.description: Sales produced per field technician.
kpis.recommendedAction: Compare technicians; coach or re-route the lowest.

kpis.name: Callback rate
kpis.description: Share of jobs that needed an unpaid return visit.
kpis.recommendedAction: Find the technicians and job types driving callbacks; they erase job margin.

kpis.name: Lead-to-booked-job conversion
kpis.description: Share of incoming leads that become booked jobs.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review call handling and quote follow-up.

kpis.name: Gross margin on jobs
kpis.description: What is left after materials and field labor, per dollar of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review job costing on the lowest-margin job types; use flat-rate pricing built from real costs.

kpis.name: Materials as % of revenue
kpis.description: Material and other direct non-labor cost per dollar of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Check that markups have kept up with supplier price increases.

kpis.name: EBITDA margin
kpis.description: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization per dollar of revenue.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review efficiency and pricing if this trails your target.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Sera 4 Metrics" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites top-performing field service companies at EBITDA margins of 15% or more.

kpis.name: Net profit margin
kpis.description: Pretax profit kept from each dollar of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Work the levers in order: price, volume sold, variable costs, fixed costs.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "7 Financial Strategies for Plumbing Companies" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites healthy plumbing companies targeting net profit of 15%–25%.

kpis.name: Accounts receivable days
kpis.description: How many days of sales are still waiting to be collected.
kpis.recommendedAction: Assign one owner for collections; follow up at 30, 60 and 90 days; take deposits or retainers.

kpis.name: Close rate
kpis.description: Share of estimates that become signed jobs.
kpis.recommendedAction: If leads are up but sales are not, the issue is closing — review the sales process and follow-up.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Master Roofing Owners Guide" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites a 30% close rate described as low in its planning example.

kpis.name: Average ticket
kpis.description: Average revenue per completed job.
kpis.recommendedAction: Focus sales effort on replacements and commercial work; add gutters, siding or solar.

kpis.name: Average job margin
kpis.description: Gross profit per dollar of sales, before labor.
kpis.recommendedAction: Monitor margins monthly; negotiate bulk material pricing before the busy season.

kpis.name: Lead-to-estimate rate
kpis.description: Share of leads that reach an estimate.
kpis.recommendedAction: Tighten lead response time and appointment setting.

kpis.name: Cost per lead
kpis.description: Marketing spend for each lead generated.
kpis.recommendedAction: Shift budget toward the channels producing leads that close.

kpis.name: Marketing as % of revenue
kpis.description: Marketing spend per dollar of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Compare with growth achieved; pre-season campaigns should show up in leads.

kpis.name: Revenue per crew
kpis.description: Sales produced per installation crew.
kpis.recommendedAction: Check scheduling and crew capacity before hiring.

kpis.name: Sales goal attainment
kpis.description: Revenue for the month against the monthly goal set in the annual plan.
kpis.recommendedAction: Work back from the goal: goal ÷ average ticket = jobs needed; jobs ÷ close rate = estimates needed.

sources: Building Your All-Star Team: A Hiring Pipeline Blueprint for Law Firms (Crisp)

kpis.name: Billable utilization
kpis.description: Share of available professional hours that were billable.
kpis.recommendedAction: Rebalance workloads and review non-billable commitments.

kpis.name: Billed hours vs target
kpis.description: Hours billed compared with the timekeepers' targets.
kpis.recommendedAction: Set clear weekly and monthly targets; coach or reassign underperformers.

kpis.name: Realization rate
kpis.description: Amount billed relative to the standard value of time worked.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review write-downs by matter and fee arrangements.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Law Firm Profit Leaks" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites aiming for 90% of billed hours to reach invoices.

kpis.name: Collection rate
kpis.description: Cash collected relative to amounts billed. Excludes trust funds.
kpis.recommendedAction: Assign one person to own collections; use evergreen retainers.
kpis.dataSource: Billing system (operating account only — trust funds are never included)

kpis.name: Accounts receivable days
kpis.description: How many days of sales are still waiting to be collected.
kpis.recommendedAction: Assign one owner for collections; follow up at 30, 60 and 90 days; take deposits or retainers.

kpis.name: Revenue per professional
kpis.description: Revenue for each fee-earning professional.
kpis.recommendedAction: Compare with compensation and utilization.

kpis.name: Cost per lead
kpis.description: Marketing spend for each lead.
kpis.recommendedAction: Track every lead source; move budget to the channels that convert.

kpis.name: Cost to acquire a client
kpis.description: Marketing spend for each new client signed.
kpis.recommendedAction: Follow up on no-shows and non-buyers.

kpis.name: Payroll as % of revenue
kpis.description: All pay, taxes and benefits per dollar of revenue.
kpis.recommendedAction: Compare with timekeeper output before adding non-billable roles.

kpis.name: Marketing as % of revenue
kpis.description: Marketing spend per dollar of revenue.
kpis.recommendedAction: Cut spend that cannot be traced to signed clients.

kpis.name: Overhead as % of revenue
kpis.description: Rent, software and other overhead per dollar of revenue.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review subscriptions, seats and contracts every six months.

kpis.name: Net profit margin
kpis.description: Pretax profit kept from each dollar of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Work the levers in order: price, volume sold, variable costs, fixed costs.

kpis.name: Team turnover
kpis.description: Share of the team that left during the period.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review hiring criteria and onboarding for the roles that churn.

kpis.name: Average days to fill a role
kpis.description: Average time from opening a role to an accepted offer.
kpis.recommendedAction: Keep a standing pipeline for key roles.

kpis.name: Scrap and rework rate
kpis.description: Cost of scrap and rework as a share of direct costs.
kpis.recommendedAction: Identify the products and steps generating the most scrap.

kpis.name: Capacity utilization
kpis.description: Share of available machine time in productive use.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review scheduling and changeover time.

kpis.name: Throughput per machine hour
kpis.description: Units produced for each machine hour.
kpis.recommendedAction: Investigate bottleneck steps.

kpis.name: Days in inventory
kpis.description: How long inventory sits before it is sold.
kpis.recommendedAction: Reduce order quantities on slow-moving items.

kpis.name: Revenue per available provider hour (RevPAH)
kpis.description: Revenue earned for each hour providers were available. Aggregate hours only — no patient information.
kpis.recommendedAction: Fill open blocks; review the service mix by margin, time and demand.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Med Spa Operations Profitability Playbook" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites a well-optimized med spa at $200–$400 RevPAH depending on services and location.

kpis.name: Client lifetime value
kpis.description: Average revenue per client over their whole relationship, for a tracked group of clients.
kpis.recommendedAction: Use memberships and maintenance plans to extend relationships.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Med Spa Operations Profitability Playbook" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites a healthy CLV of $2,000–$5,000 for established practices.

kpis.name: Treatment plan completion rate
kpis.description: Share of recommended treatment plans that clients complete.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review the consultation process, pricing structure and follow-up.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Med Spa Operations Profitability Playbook" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites investigating when completion falls below 70%.

kpis.name: Cost per new client
kpis.description: Marketing spend for each new client.
kpis.recommendedAction: Compare with first-year revenue per new client.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Med Spa Operations Profitability Playbook" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites acquisition cost of typically 10%–15% of a client's first-year revenue.

kpis.name: Consultation-to-treatment conversion
kpis.description: Share of consultations that lead to a booked treatment.
kpis.recommendedAction: Standardize the consultation and present options clearly.

kpis.name: Membership revenue share
kpis.description: Share of revenue that is recurring membership income.
kpis.recommendedAction: Design tiers for different client needs and budgets.

kpis.name: Revenue per provider
kpis.description: Revenue for each provider.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review schedules and service mix by provider.

kpis.name: Provider utilization
kpis.description: Share of available provider hours that were booked.
kpis.recommendedAction: Fill open blocks; review no-show policy.

kpis.name: Average transaction value
kpis.description: Average revenue per visit.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review service bundles and product attachment.

kpis.name: Rebooking rate
kpis.description: Share of visits that left with a next appointment booked.
kpis.recommendedAction: Coach front-desk checkout on rebooking.

kpis.name: Staffing as % of revenue
kpis.description: All pay, taxes and benefits per dollar of revenue.
kpis.recommendedAction: Tie bonuses to revenue, retention and booking conversion.

sources: Mining for Hidden Cash: The Hidden Cash Map for Independent Optometrists (Prowise)

kpis.name: Sales to assets
kpis.description: Revenue generated for each dollar invested in the practice. Very high can signal capacity limits ahead.
kpis.recommendedAction: A low result may mean income can grow without buying more equipment.

kpis.name: Gross profit margin
kpis.description: Revenue kept after frames, lenses and lab fees.
kpis.recommendedAction: Renegotiate supplier contracts, adjust pricing or improve product mix.

kpis.name: Net profit margin
kpis.description: Pretax profit kept from each dollar of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Work the levers in order: price, volume sold, variable costs, fixed costs.

kpis.name: Days in inventory
kpis.description: How long frames and other stock sit on the shelf.
kpis.recommendedAction: Order less next time on slow lines; set an optimal stock level.
kpis.dataSource: Inventory value at period end; management P&L

kpis.name: Accounts receivable days
kpis.description: How many days of sales are still waiting to be collected.
kpis.recommendedAction: Assign one owner for collections; follow up at 30, 60 and 90 days; take deposits or retainers.

kpis.name: Accounts payable days
kpis.description: How many days the practice takes to pay suppliers. Best kept steady.
kpis.recommendedAction: Paying too fast strains cash; paying too slowly risks late fees and vendor relationships.

kpis.name: Cash gap (days)
kpis.formula: inventory / cogs * period_days + accounts_receivable / revenue * period_days - accounts_payable / cogs * period_days
kpis.description: Days between paying suppliers and collecting from patients and insurers.
kpis.recommendedAction: Shorten collection time and inventory days before stretching payables.
kpis.dataSource: Balance sheet; inventory value; management P&L

kpis.name: Revenue per exam
kpis.description: Average revenue per patient exam (aggregate count only).
kpis.recommendedAction: Review optical capture and product mix.

sources: 7 Portfolio Multipliers for Property Management (image-only PDF, read by OCR)

kpis.name: Revenue per unit managed
kpis.description: Management company revenue for each door under management.
kpis.recommendedAction: Add value-adding services: maintenance, resident benefit packages, pet rent.

kpis.name: Management contract retention
kpis.description: Share of owner clients retained over the period.
kpis.recommendedAction: Communicate proactively with owners; review the accounts that left.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "7 Portfolio Multipliers" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites retaining at least 90% of owners each year.

kpis.name: Owner lead conversion
kpis.description: Share of owner leads that sign a management contract.
kpis.recommendedAction: Lead with concrete results in the sales conversation.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "7 Portfolio Multipliers" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites the best property managers converting 50% or more.

kpis.name: Ancillary revenue share
kpis.description: Share of revenue from services beyond the base management fee.
kpis.recommendedAction: Small per-unit additions compound across the portfolio.

kpis.name: Units per employee
kpis.description: Doors managed per team member — a measure of workflow efficiency.
kpis.recommendedAction: Automate rent collection, maintenance requests and accounting.

kpis.name: Net profit margin
kpis.description: Pretax profit kept from each dollar of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Work the levers in order: price, volume sold, variable costs, fixed costs.

kpis.name: Reinvestment rate
kpis.description: Share of earnings reinvested in technology, marketing or acquisitions.
kpis.recommendedAction: Plan reinvestment in the annual budget.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "7 Portfolio Multipliers" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites reinvesting 10%–20% of earnings.

kpis.name: Portfolio occupancy
kpis.description: Share of managed units that are occupied.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review pricing and turn time on vacant units.

kpis.name: Rent delinquency
kpis.description: Share of billed rent that is past due.
kpis.recommendedAction: Tighten collection workflow and follow-up.

kpis.name: Occupancy
kpis.description: Share of units occupied.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review pricing and turn time on vacant units.

kpis.name: Rent collection rate
kpis.description: Rent collected relative to rent billed.
kpis.recommendedAction: Follow up on delinquent accounts.

kpis.name: Net operating income margin
kpis.description: Operating income per dollar of rental revenue.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review property operating expenses by category.

kpis.name: Debt service coverage ratio
kpis.description: Operating income available to cover scheduled debt payments.
kpis.recommendedAction: If coverage is tight, review rents, expenses and refinancing options.

kpis.name: Capital reserve funding
kpis.description: Share of revenue set aside for capital expenditures.
kpis.recommendedAction: Fund reserves before distributions.

sources: The Build Your Restaurant Launch Field Guide

kpis.name: Food cost %
kpis.description: Food and beverage cost as a share of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review portioning, waste and supplier pricing; cost each menu item per serving.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Build Your Restaurant Launch Field Guide" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites aiming for a 25%–35% food cost ratio.

kpis.name: Labor cost %
kpis.description: Total labor as a share of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Match scheduling to sales by daypart.

kpis.name: Prime cost %
kpis.description: Food cost plus labor as a share of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Address whichever of food cost or labor has moved most.

kpis.name: Gross profit after prime cost
kpis.description: What is left after food cost and labor, per dollar of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Use it to see whether sales growth is reaching the bottom line.

kpis.name: Average check
kpis.description: Average sales per guest.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review menu pricing and upsell.

kpis.name: Table turnover (turns per seat per day)
kpis.description: How many guests each seat serves per day open.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review service pace and reservation spacing at peak times.
kpis.dataSource: POS guest count; seating; days open

kpis.name: Sales per labor hour
kpis.description: Sales for each hour of labor scheduled.
kpis.recommendedAction: Adjust staffing on slow shifts.

kpis.name: Operating expense ratio
kpis.description: Operating expenses per dollar of sales.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review the largest categories against budget.

kpis.name: Contribution margin ratio
kpis.description: Share of each sales dollar left after food cost and direct labor.
kpis.recommendedAction: Promote the menu items with the highest contribution.

kpis.name: Break-even revenue
kpis.description: Sales needed in the period to cover operating expenses at the current contribution margin.
kpis.recommendedAction: Compare with actual sales by week to see how much cushion there is.

kpis.name: Inventory turnover
kpis.description: How many times inventory was used and replaced in the period.
kpis.recommendedAction: Reduce par levels on slow items.

kpis.name: Waste as % of food cost
kpis.description: Recorded waste as a share of food and beverage cost.
kpis.recommendedAction: Look for over-prepping, spoilage and evidence of theft.

kpis.name: Current ratio
kpis.description: Short-term assets available to cover short-term obligations.
kpis.recommendedAction: Below 1.0 means near-term bills exceed near-term resources.
kpis.benchmarkNote: Reference only, not a target: "Mastering Restaurant Accounting" (vendor guide, undated, not independently verified) cites verifying the current ratio is above 1.

kpis.name: Debt service coverage ratio
kpis.description: Operating cash earnings available to cover loan payments.
kpis.recommendedAction: Lenders look at this before extending credit.

kpis.name: Revenue per employee
kpis.description: Revenue for each team member.
kpis.recommendedAction: Compare with fully loaded cost per employee.

kpis.name: Billable utilization
kpis.description: Share of available hours that were billable.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review non-billable time by person.

kpis.name: Accounts receivable days
kpis.description: How many days of sales are still waiting to be collected.
kpis.recommendedAction: Assign one owner for collections; follow up at 30, 60 and 90 days; take deposits or retainers.

kpis.name: Average repair order
kpis.description: Average sales per repair order.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review inspection and estimate presentation.

kpis.name: Effective labor rate
kpis.description: Labor sales for each hour billed.
kpis.recommendedAction: Compare with the posted rate; review discounting.

kpis.name: Technician efficiency
kpis.description: Hours billed relative to hours technicians were clocked in.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review dispatching and parts wait time.

kpis.name: Parts gross margin
kpis.description: Gross margin earned on parts.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review the parts pricing matrix.

kpis.name: Program expense ratio
kpis.description: Share of total expenses spent on programs.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review allocation of shared costs.

kpis.name: Cost to raise a dollar
kpis.description: Fundraising cost for each dollar contributed.
kpis.recommendedAction: Review the return on each fundraising channel.

kpis.name: Operating runway (months)
kpis.description: Months of expenses covered by unrestricted cash. Restricted funds are excluded.
kpis.recommendedAction: Build unrestricted reserves before expanding programs.

kpis.name: Largest funder share
kpis.description: Share of contributions coming from the single largest funder.
kpis.recommendedAction: Diversify funding sources.
